title: valeriana sitchensis subsp. scouleri
intro: Valeriana sitchensis subsp. scouleri, commonly known as Scouler's valerian, is a subspecies of flowering plant in the valerian family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to promote relaxation and reduce anxiety, as well as its potential to alleviate insomnia and other sleep disorders. The health benefits of Scouler's valerian are attributed to its therapeutic actions, which include sedation, anxiolytic, and anti-inflammatory effects, as well as its ability to modulate the nervous system. The bioactive constituents of Scouler's valerian include valerenic acid, isovaleric acid, and valepotriates, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
